lines: By reflection-ness by mirror-ness and from consciousness; this invocation principal like fan of winds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pratibimbatayā paśyedbimbatvena ca bodhataḥ etadāvāhanaṃ mukhyaṃ vyajanānmarutāmiva
